data: Which source type has the highest frequency in the FinLin corpus in the plot with the higher y-axis?

The question asks which source type has the highest frequency in the FinLin corpus in the plot with the higher y-axis. From the caption, we know that the bottom plot shows the distribution for the Company Reports, Investor Reports, and News, using a smaller y-axis. Therefore, the top plot is the one with the higher y-axis.

Looking at the top plot, the blue line represents StockTwits, and it appears to have the highest frequency among all the source types throughout the time period shown. The other lines (Company Reports, Investor Reports, and News) have much lower frequencies compared to the blue line.

Thus, the source type with the highest frequency in the FinLin corpus in the plot with the higher y-axis is StockTwits.
